title: Create a Robot
instructions: Complete the `Robot` class so it has a `name` property of type `String`. Then in the `main` function, create a `Robot` with the name `"Tribots Bot"` and print its name.
hint: Add `val name: String` inside the parentheses of the class. Then create an instance with `Robot("Tribots Bot")` and use `println(robot.name)`.
